summary: Build AI risk registers, control matrices, and board-ready reporting in 5 days. Learn practical governance for responsible AI adoption.
lede: AI governance and risk management help professionals set oversight for AI systems and address model, data, and use-case risks. For risk, compliance, audit, and data professionals, the course covers assessing and scoring AI risks, mapping risks to controls, and establishing monitoring and escalation workflows. Participants also practice documenting governance responsibilities and preparing audit evidence and reporting for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to govern AI use responsibly, manage model-related risks, and build defensible compliance workflows across business and technology teams.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with AI use cases, enterprise risk concepts, and compliance processes. Prior experience in governance, data management, internal audit, information security, legal review, or technology assurance will help you move faster, but no coding is required. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with hands-on use of templates, scorecards, and control matrices rather than technical model engineering.
